title: Consolidate duplicated staleness check between mcp.rs and main.rs
description: The staleness check logic (parse timestamp, compute age, call workspace_has_changed) is duplicated between SutraServer::freshness() in mcp.rs and maybe_reparse_cwd() in main.rs. Both were updated independently in the is_stale rework (d604ae7, ae75a02). Extract a single function that takes the DB, workspace root, and threshold, and returns the freshness JSON or stale bool.

acceptance_criteria.text: A single public function `is_workspace_stale(db, workspace_root, threshold_sec) -> (Option<String>, bool)` exists in `src/freshness.rs`
`SutraServer::freshness` in `src/mcp.rs` delegates to the new function (no inline staleness logic)
`maybe_reparse_cwd` in `src/main.rs` delegates to the new function (no inline staleness logic)
Behavioral parity: both call sites produce identical results as before
